data.name: Vani
data.gender_notes: Vani is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Vani is the goddess of speech and wisdom. She is the messenger of the gods, carrying their messages to the world. She is also known as the goddess of knowledge and eloquence. The name Vani carries the meaning “Messenger, Voice” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Vani usually hope their child will grow to embody messenger, voice and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power of speech and the importance of clear communication in expressing one's truth and connecting with others.
data.etymology: Vani belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Messenger, Voice.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vani total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: Vani is a significant name in Hindu culture, representing the power of speech and communication. It is believed that those named Vani possess the gift of eloquence and the ability to express their thoughts clearly and persuasively. In Hindu literature, Vani is depicted as the divine messenger of the gods, who carries their messages to the world. She is also a symbol of knowledge and education, making Vani a revered and respected name in Hindu culture.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spirituality, Vani represents the power of the goddess of speech and wisdom. She is believed to be the divine voice that speaks truth and inspires knowledge and understanding. Those named Vani are said to be connected to this divine power, making them carriers of knowledge and truth. Vani is also a symbol of the divine mother, who nurtures and guides her children with her wisdom and insight. By invoking the name of Vani, one can seek her blessings for eloquence, knowledge, and the ability to express one's truth authentically and wisely.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Vani signifies the divine voice of knowledge and truth. It is a name for the Goddess Saraswati, the embodiment of wisdom and speech. In Hindu philosophy, Vani represents the power of words to inspire, heal, and enlighten.
